title: The Hospital That Stole 100,000 Gallons of Blood for Profit
hook: They sold donated blood to private clinics — but never told the donors.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into universal trust in blood donation, then shatters it — high emotional shock value.

title: The Cancer Treatment That Was Actually Industrial-Grade Rat Poison
hook: It was sold as 'alternative therapy' — patients drank it convinced it would save them.
why_this_can_go_viral: Desperation of cancer patients exploited — triggers rage and pity, highly shareable.
